about: The shared test vector of the `2.` link encoding without a base (web/src/lib/playground/project/overlay-link.ts): the link opens over the full starting project. rocketh-website hand-ports the encoder (web/open-in-playground/overlay-link.js) and keeps a copy of the decoder in its tests, both held to this file and to overlay-link-bare-vector.json: encodeOverlay(files, select) must give exactly `value`. A change to the encoding changes these files and both repositories together.
